sources: Lebanon's state-run National News Agency (NNA), via Al Jazeera liveblog Oct 31
fault_line: Ceasefire or cover? Strikes north of the Litani under a truce that "exists only in name" -- who enforces it?

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Israeli warplanes carried out strikes on towns in southern Lebanon: first strike between Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Kfar Tebnit (Nabatieh district), second on the outskirts of Baraachit (Bint Jbeil district), per NNA via AJ liveblog. AJ liveblog also reports NNA machinegun fire on Wadi al-Hujeir woodland and Chaqra outskirts (05:45 GMT entry, pre-window) and continued demolitions/shelling in Bint Jbeil and Tyre districts. No casualty figure attached to the 11:40 strikes in-window.
sections.what_verified: 1 counted family (Al Jazeera T2 STATE (QA) relaying NNA); NNA itself carries no declared tier and is not counted.
sections.what_disputed: No IDF comment located in-window; the April 17 US-mediated Israel-Lebanon ceasefire framework is the standing counter-frame (AJ liveblog: ceasefire "exists only in name" per its Beirut correspondent, on the older May-dated edgeone piece -- treated as analysis, not a fresh fact).
sections.why_matters: Lebanon under the Iran-war shadow: new strikes in Nabatieh/Bint Jbeil while Doha talks are claimed
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 07:40 GMT = 11:40 ) -- Israeli warplanes strike southern Lebanon: Nabatieh al-Fawqa/Kfar Tebnit and Baraachit outskirts (NNA via AJ)

totw_analysis: Our read: Lebanon under the Iran-war shadow: new strikes in Nabatieh/Bint Jbeil while Doha talks are claimed The fault line our audience is arguing over: Ceasefire or cover? Strikes north of the Litani under a truce that "exists only in name" -- who enforces it?
